channel.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!" - "No, no, you don't get it at all. I mean 'Holiday Art Exchange.' You know, Secret Santa and ho-ho-ho and presents to pretty people?"

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Voice work, a story, or a video.

What I am looking for: A link to a new story featuring Jeremiah Cimmerian in the Aces and Eights canon. You can use the information presented on the hub page to get an idea of what he's like in that canon, or ask me.

I don't care about the secret part of the whole art exchange thing, but if you're committed to that for some reason, you can go through an intermediary to ask me any questions.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
It's funny, I and Elogee got saddled with this because we don't find this to be a pain in the ass to manage. The entire process is very, very fun. Thank you for creating something so wonderful for the site to experience and enjoy each year. Seriously, this is my favorite thing that happens on this wiki, and it wouldn't exist without you.

Merry Santamas indeed. (And yeah, nearly a decade of this wonderfulness, isn't that crazy!?)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I’d like to write you a tale or SCP based on your favourite article or anything else! I’m not much of a character author so I’d like to avoid writing the big names (bright, clef, etc.) if possible. Writing about science, horror, and short pieces are my specialty! If you want something weirder than normal stuff, I could try to make you a presentation or something on why your favourite article, most hated article, or anything really, is actually the best thing on the wiki.

What I Am Looking For: I would really like some art for any of my works or tale inspired by them or really anything else! If you really need some inspiration, I always enjoy reading articles that mix horror with humour!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Last-minute entry here we go 😳

What I can give: Anything writing-related I can take a stab at. I'm willing to try SCPs, tales, even GoI formats if needed.

What I am looking for: Art or writing relating to the Limited Memory series would be great.

Alternatively, I'd appreciate prose that inspires wonder (think 'Wanderer's Library'). It doesn't have to be set in any specific canon or universe. Art or music set in the same general genre would be great if writing isn't your strong suit.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: Drawings (both traditional and digital) and/or small songs (~2 minutes) :>

What I am looking for: A little drawing or misc content of my wip canon 'Transuniversal Pandemonium' or my previously posted articles would be fine n.n

edit: transuniversal pandemonium stuff here and my articles here (it's mainly in spanish, hope u don't mind 😅)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: SCPs, tales or GOI formats. I've only done the Nobody and Chaos Insurgency format before, but they're all not that difficult to learn. I'm probably better at making something, that's already established.

What I am looking for: An article about my Explanation and Research Department short ExaRD (managing Explained SCPs) or its head, Director Weld. There is an Orientation about the Department, that will be posted soon. Until then you can find it in my sandbox under "Orientation-EX". To a lesser extant, ExaRD is also mentioned in SCP-2023-EX and Director Weld is featured in In Response to Nuclear Warheads. If you can't do that, feel free to make art of any of the things I posted.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Okay, this is probably the first one of these I actually have time for, so I might as well put my name down.

What I can give: I can write SCPs or tales, although I'm better at the former. I lean towards concept-driven articles rather than sappy emotional stories. I'm also a cellist, for what that's worth.

What I am looking for: I will take art or an article featuring any of my solo SCPs (SCP-2801, SCP-3631, or SCP-4943), but I would especially like an article featuring my home-grown GOI Ravensgate Security Services. The short version is that they are a security firm that does pentesting, consulting, etc. for other GOIs, including the Foundation. I don't expect them to get very big - they are admittedly very niche - but I do want to flesh them out. For characters, you could include David Keyes's team, or you could write your own. The organizational structure isn't very well defined so far, so you have some freedom on that front. All I ask is that they remain a benevolent force, or at least a neutral one.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can write anything that doesn't involve fancy coding but am best with Tales. Specifically Tales that are based mostly on plot and narrative, I'm not super good with dialogue. One thing to note is that all three of the Tales I had published have been pretty short, but I think I could write something longer if I needed to. I can make traditional art as well with black and white pencil and charcoal drawings but I'm still relatively new with that. If needed I would definitely be able to make some art, but would be more comfortable doing some writing if possible. Note that I am really bad at drawing faces.

What I Am Looking For: What I want is just some art. I don't really care what it is, I just would like art depicting something from one of the six Tales and SCPs I've written so far.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I never wrote directly on the site but I'm writing a novel so I am confident in my capacity to write tales. I'm better with fantasy based stuff and my first language is french, but I'll try my best to do what the person wants.

What I Am Looking For: Literally anything would make me happy, but I would love an SCP or a tale based around a "critic", maybe an anomalous entity that is a reviewer of timelines and worlds or something like that, to reference the "So… I finished" reviews and critiques of different series and canons I do on the SCP subreddit. (u/Retrom17 if you need a reference) And if that's too much to ask from me and art is better for you, my favorite SCPs are 1867, 3300 and 507.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Art! I have a very diverse style, of which you can see examples of in the different chapters of my webcomic Outissa. Every chapter is a different style. :D

What I Am Looking For: A skip or tale that takes place in a reality where the GOC has become such a huge threat that a bunch of GoIs banded together to create the Foundation. In this reality, the O5 Council is made up of representatives from different GoIs. :O

If that's too specific/weird/difficult, then I'll take a skip that somehow involves the concept of "cuteness aggression."

Thanks! <3

I can write Tales and GoI formats. I can also do pixelart of scenes and objects, preferably not characters.

I'd love some art of my GoI format: Critter Profile: Arorangi!, or else of something that I have written for our sister site The Wanderer's Library, which you can find on my Author Page

What I Am Looking For: Maybe a drawing I can use as a profile picture like me as a d-class with an scp. If you were to do this ill describe myself lol.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can write tales and poetry of any sort! Love writing weird sci-fi and western stuff (cyberpunk too!) but I'm always happy to try and experiment.

What I Am Looking For: Anything for my pieces on the site! That would be SCP-4328 and the tale "What if People Were Bees"! (if you'd like, anything to do with SCP-3368 and its world would be awesome as well! would love to see more beepocalypse stuff.)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Last year's was fun. Returning from hiatus to contribute again is a no-brainer.

What I can give: Epistolary fiction, poetry, skips and short stories. Nothing solely romance-focused, or sexually explicit.

What I'm looking for:

  • Translations, audio adaptations, or analyses of SCP-5042 or SCP-5984.
  • A skip or tale expanding upon Agent Hopper, the Serpents' Hand aligned version of SCP-507 from Snippets of an Unveiled World.
  • A Parawatch article in the style of a Wiki page.
  • A skip or Parawatch tale about Westhead Media.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can Give: Digital art of pretty much anything, sprite comics, sprite animations, and music.

What I'm Looking For: I'm going to be selfish and ask for art of one of my five articles: either SCP-4441 - Summer Scare,
SCP-4832 - 📻 👌,
SCP-5043 - dado's brainexplsoesenotsrsogsgsdgkpskplsdhpsd, …uh, the… do, the make the your brains have a blow splosion,
SCP-5114 Bureaucratic Warfare, or
SCP-248-J - Picture it

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: An honest try at poetry, (paper) drawings, images for articles, and I don't mind attempting to write a tale if the original SCP isn't too complex or not from a big hub. This is my first exchange so please don't expect top-notch quality.

What I Am Looking For: If you are up for it, I'd love a tale, drawing or a simple poem about SCP-5147 (you can mention your own instances if you like to).

If the SCP above or the idea does not speak to you, I'd love to learn/see/read something about an animal or a plant that doesn't appear in Europe.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Poetry, short stories, logo/glyph-style art.

What I Am Looking For: I love art of my work and I'm always excited to receive more of it. That being said, I also really love poetry and archaic-style religious scripture. I'm a history buff, what can I say?

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: Anything related to photos. Need an original or free to use image or photo of an obscure location or object for one of your articles? I can get you one. I can also offer my help for any article ideas you may need (although probably not with the actual writing of the article… I kinda suck in that)

What I'm looking for: My poor only SCP in this site, SCP-4562 had a nice tale written about it last year, which was sadly never posted. This year I'm looking for something similar : someone to expand on the article, either with a tale, a test log, or something similar.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Tales or poetry (especially in narrative style) on a specified subject, potentially jewelry or textile art if you would be okay with a physical gift

What I Am Looking For: Daevite, Sarkic, CotBG, or Kadakúni artwork or articles. Or photo-manips of deformed organisms I could use for articles.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: An SCP Group of Interest/MTF/SCP related logo (Revamped) or any specific/random SCP artwork that you like (except scenery types ain't good at it).

What I am Looking For: Any Scenery Art with any SCP with maybe some tips on scenery/background art making would do. No need make it fancy, Simplicity with Care is all good ( ^^).

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: An SCP or tale based on a prompt or existing article, or a photoshopped image. (I'm reasonably skilled see image on 5733 for an example). Ideally the writing piece wouldn't be too heavily based in a particular canon.

What I am Looking For: Any artwork or a tale based on one of my existing skips. I would be particularly keen for any sort of help in improving my writing (For example: knowledge sharing of writing techniques, guidance on how to plan an article, a single 1-on-1 seminar etc) but aware this is something that may not be offered up!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Always looking forward to the Exchange. Thanks to both of you, DarkStuff and Elogee, for once again gracing us with this. You (and other, past hosts) bring joy to all the land each year.

What I Can Give: I'll write a Tale to your specifications. Whether it's set in your favourite setting/Canon, or involves your favourite Group of Interest, it doesn't matter; I'll do it. For ideas as to what I can offer — in past Art Exchange events I wrote these: 2018 | 2019.

+ A note (click me)
What I Can't Give
I cannot or will not write about any of the following: Characters which are first-generation Senior Staff Author Avatars (Drs. Clef, Kondraki, Gears, Bright — that sort of thing); the Bellerverse, Competitive Eschatology, lolFoundation, or Resurrection canons; or the Sarkicism GOI. No hard feelings — these are just areas in which I have little interest or understanding.
- A note

What I Am Looking For: An SCP, Tale, GOI Format, Artwork, OR Wanderers' Library Entry based on any of my pages. If you need something more specific, I would be especially delighted if any of these were depicted:

  • SCP-3309 and the Adamo Smalls & Heather Mason stories (I, II, III).
  • Team Bird/the Avian Division. Preferably set before the Migration scenario.
  • Moosphere, Incorporated. Doesn't need to be set in the Broken Masquerade.
  • Lampyra and The Watchers of The Lost Glade. Doesn't need to be set in the Broken Masquerade.
  • Something which builds on one of my obscure works! *cough Solidão, A Necromantic Prelude cough*

And preferably something you can post to the Wiki (optional, of course)!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Writing. Format doesn't matter much. Much of what I write is about bureaucrats cutting ethical corners and people making bad decisions for bad reasons. No promise for a happy ending, but it could happen.

I can also do some software development as long it's not web-based and you don't mind dealing with a command line. Mostly linux-y stuff but anything I do there can be ported to Windows.

What I Am Looking For: Art or other media of my articles. If you're looking for characters, look no further than:

  • Madison Craggs, renegade scientist who sometimes confuses 'right and wrong' with 'right and left'. See also OCT entries.
  • A particular Japanese admiral who takes center stage in Setting Sun or his Foundation contact.
  • Jane Mossbury, a woman who has made it her life's work to keep everyone in the dark.
  • The endless bickering among the Ethics Committee, which would be amusing if not for the impossible stakes in SCP-3554

But any article is fair game.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: Mostly tales and other similar formats, like this tale from the 2016 Art Exchange, or this tale from the 2017 exchange.

What I am looking for: If visual art is something you do, I'd love art of characters from Comedown Machine and Under Control, especially of Adam and Casey together. But any art of Casey, Adam, Vera, or Eustace would be lovely.

Another option for art would be characters from the ongoing Cool War 2 arc, written in the Canon Renaissance Contest by the Ruiz Duchamp Memorial Contest Team. Specifically Felicity Baudin (superplagiarist), Tanksy (the tankie banksy), and Casio (a 3d printer).

Alternately, I like tales, SCP articles, or other writing! Especially if they involve Laika's Sweetheart Space-Beacon, The Friendly Vacuum, or The Internet of Things That Are Wolves.

I will also accept art of the climactic battle from Clash of the Cosmic Comedians, but if you send me just art of Tim Allen alone I will come to your house and yell at you.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: SCP articles or tales, possibly a GoI format based around something of your liking :). I can also use photoshop to a degree. I mainly deal with articles will sillier tones or concepts but I could try to tackle something more serious

What I Am Looking For: Something involving one of my articles, take your pick. If I had to choose one either SCP-5993 or SCP-4966 but any of my articles would be lovely.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can give a traditional or digital piece of art! If the person I am given is okay with being sent mail, if love to do a handwritten letter for their scp/ocs and send them the signed art!

What I Am Looking For: Art of my tale Goodnight, Miss Moon, or stories written about it! If you know my social medias art or writing of any of my ocs work as well :)!

Ps. I am willing to be a pincher! I draw a full piece everyday and would be more than happy to help

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Stories! Tales, SCPs, GoI Formats, I’ll do ‘em all, but I’m best at character/dialogue driven work. Maybe poetry, but I’m not practiced at it.

What I’m Looking For: Stories about or art of La Rue Macabre! For stories anything in La Rue is fine, but I would mostly like art of what's listed on the second and fourth tabs of La Rue’s hub :)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Tales. Character tales, SCP focused tales, GoI tales. More tales than Tails.

What I Am Looking For: Personally, I'd like art featuring Agent Sasha Merlo. In particular:

  • A depiction of the entire Merlo Family
  • Evolution of Sasha Merlo from UIU agent to Site Director
  • Something showing her in action tracking down Anderson Robotics

The above are mere ideas, though. I'm always down for surprises.

Barring that, a tale featuring the character would also be cool.

A fairly cut and dry description of the character can also be found on the "character discussion" tab of my author page.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: SCP's or Tales of any sort. However, I don't do well with more technology-centric ones.

What I am Looking For: Art of either my SCP: 4258 or my Tale: Last of the Hand. I'd also accept an SCP, tale, or art using my author avatar, Dr. Barnes. Reference art of Barnes can be found in the comments on the aforementioned page.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can write SCPs, tales, or GoI formats. I also do iconography and logos, and I can even make a video about your article!

What I Am Looking For: Any sort of fan art or videos about my articles would be lovely, same with tales or other writing!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: Digitally painted Fanart, A Trouble in Terrorist town based around an SCP?

What I am looking for: Basically any kind of fanart for one of my articles, be it drawn written or whatever :)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can make a synth-based progressive electronic piece based on one of your works. My oeuvre tends to work with analog synth atmospheres, 80s sounds, and sci-fi ambiences, and my pieces can be quite complex - here's an example of one I made in the past. Declassifications - deep-diving, substantive, and personal ones - are also something I'd be happy to get back into making, although this is my second choice.

What I Am Looking For: Either (a) artwork based off anything I have written or (b) a piece of writing - tale or SCP - for the Shattered Thoughts (SCP-3426) protocanon that I've been working on for a while (if you do this, feel free to reach out to Yossipossi, Brewsterion 1017, or ValidClay for details on what it is).

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can Give: Pretty much any type of writing

What I Am Looking For: Any sort of writing, artwork, audio creation, etc. regarding one of my works not set in the End of Death canon.

Thanks DarkStuff and Elogee for putting this together!

\o/

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
I still remember the first one of these. At the time, I thought it was destined to be one-off kind of deal, but here we are, almost ten (!!!) years later and it's still going strong.

Thank you, DarkStuff, for taking over the mantle. I know what a pain in the ass managing this can be, but it's something that means a lot to a lot of people, myself included. It's not a thing that's Djoric's or Photo's or mine or even yours, so much as it the community's, and I think that's really, really cool.

So, again, thank you for taking up the work for the third year running. Merry Santamas.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I giveth: SCP articles and/or dossier files, even CC-safe images you can use for your articles. Anything connected in-universe or site lore, I can provide. I'm a simple guy.

What I search for: Tales revolving around my character, Dr. Connor MacWarren (narcissistic, I know).

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Tales. Epistolary shit.

What I Am Looking For: A tale set in French Indochina between 1870 and 1950, involving Fifthism and/or the IJMEA. Bonus points if you can incorporate Zomia and its anti-state traditions.

Alternatively, a tale or SCP that incorporates and explores the life and times of Lyle Alan Burnley, heresiographer, because I am quite fond of him.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: SCPs or tales, which may include some of my Photoshop Art. No sarkic stuff tho.

What I Am Looking For: A tale, SCP, illustration, animation, drawing etc. featuring the WIZARD BLIZZARD1

Footnotes
1. What this means is up to your interpretation. Is it a blizzard made of wizards? A blizzard made by wizards? A blizzard that turns people into wizards? I don't know. (This is an art prompt)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Writing, of almost any kind. I'm willing to work in any canon, any GoI or with any article. I can make SCPs, tales and GoI formats. I can work with just about anything. I'm not great with poetry, although I can try.

Additionally, I'm highly proficient with CSS and can make a theme for either Black Highlighter or Sigma-9, or any other kind of CSS work. Ideally you will have a logo for that theme, as I'm not a graphic designer or artist and can't make those myself.

What I Am Looking For: I'd like some form of writing or art based on one of my articles from the following list. SCP-5682 is my top choice. Anything about SCP-3668, SCP-5041, SCP-4901, Wolf Hollow, The Death of AJ Fader, Station 395 would also be very nice. The writing could be anything as long as it's not the same type (i.e. — not an SCP about the SCPs, not a Parawatch about the Parawatch).

Alternatively, and this is a bit of a longshot, a TTRPG (any game!) stat block or module or something about any of my articles, not just the list above. It can be anything related to the game, as long as it is unique and usable. D&D works for this, but I would suggest Monster of the Week or Hunter: Vigil as possibly better suited to the idea.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Short ~5-10 (if I really like the idea probably 10-30) mins character/situational comedy sketch performance about a specific topic probably one of your works
(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bJ_KaDmPKqk)
or a song, probably.

What I Am Looking For:
Any of the following will do me good for the yuletide season!
1. A song about 5092.
2. Any fanart of 5000 as there isn't much, maybe Pietro walking away from some sort of disaster holding his suitcase?
3. Anything to do with 3001 there isn't enough 3001 content out there maybe a tale somehow?
I'm very much a fan of strange, abstract and icky gross writing!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Poetry (most typically villanelles) about SCP articles.

What I Am Looking For: Something about the Kiryu Labs crew, if you please!

Big thanks to everyone who's organizing this event; it's wonderful that we can look forward to it each holiday season!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can make some arts (traditional) about your SCP.

What I Am Looking For: SCP, tale, or anything you like to do uwu

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Traditional artwork (i.e. various techniques non-digital). I'm best at drawing organic things, that is, plants, animals, humans/humanoids, of a fantastical or realistic nature. I cannot draw your favorite researcher, person of interest, or humanoid scp as a hot anime gentleman, but I can draw them in fashionable or historical garb, if that's relevant. Currently, the best place to see examples of my art is on my Instagram. My contribution to last year's art exchange can be seen on Tufto's author page

What I Am Looking For: I'd love a tale, article, or poem about a location made strange, lonely, or haunted. Something has happened here, it may be unclear just what, before the time that the story picks up, that has changed a once innocuous place into something…else. Diverse articles that have the kind of mysterious, occasionally melancholy vibes I like include: 176, 455, 1383, 2508, 2719, 2740, 3005, 3930, 4182.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can write poems about whatever you want, the entire ouroboros cycle, or a random murder monster, or that tale where wack happens. I can deliver in style! (maybe)

What I Am Looking For: Eh…. art of SCP-4576? One of my recent favorites.

item.title: My gives and takes!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: An SCP or tale, some form of digital art, a particular amount of music, or perhaps even a screenplay.

What I am looking for: Anything! Surprise me!

(but if you're indecisive like me)
go boo collapsible

Any of these work:

  • Fanart of SCP-5420 or any of my other SCPs.
  • Music-based things of anything I've written. Preferably something horror-based, like from Trapped Hare in a Film Gate. I'm partial to fake movie scores/title themes, if you can do that.
  • Anything (writing/art/etc.) for the GoI Arcadia that Roget and I created.
  • Fanart of anything pre-1986 made by Dario Argento. Yes, this isn't technically SCP, but I'd take it if someone really wanted to just do that.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can Give: I can create Logo wallpapers (examples here on my artpage) and simple logo/motion graphics animations (examples here on my Youtube channel).

What I Am Looking For: I am looking for an SCP themed wallpaper/Profile Image or an article (tales or an SCP) about romance or comedy. Just choose one of the choices. Thanks in advance :)

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: digital art of any kind. i'm primarily a 3D artist, but i sometimes do 2D stuff. here's some art i've made for the wiki. i can also make renders for your articles if you want.

What I Am Looking For:

  • fan art for any of my articles… not sure if any of them are particularly fan art worthy but the option is there!!
  • write an article involving the department of psychodentistry
  • talloran content of any kind…….. :pleading_face:

(EDIT: if radguel receives my request, they are specifically required to do an interpretative dance pertaining to any of the above options. this is non-negotiable. (unless they really dont want to))

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can write SCPs or tales, preferably about things that don't require much background reading or lore knowledge. This excludes Wanderer's Library, since I love the site a lot and want to write more for it. I can't promise anything too long but I'll do my best. Edit: I was also bullied by Jak into saying I can make memes, but I'm not gonna do that unless you like, specifically request it.

What I Am Looking For: Any of these, I'm not particularly picky (no NSFW though please):

  • Something featuring MTF Eta-77 ("Spheres Within Spheres") and/or the Department of Tactical Theology (SCP, Tale, GoI Format, anything really).
  • Art, music, readings, etc. of one of my articles (this excludes SCP-3635 and SCP-4213, anything else is fine (yes, even the 6000 entry contest, if you really want to, for some reason)) or something I like.
  • Something you are certain I would like, whatever you feel that is.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Hi!

What I can Give: I am literally always down to write poetry. I'm down to write it about an SCP (as evidenced in book-club, a person, or really anything. I'd probably go for a Sonnet or Ballad, but if I feel a villanelle or Sestina or something seems to fit it better then I'll go with that.

I'm also happy to write a declass of one of your articles if it seems complicated/confusing enough.

EDIT: Depending on your body of work, I may be able to perform and record an interpretive dance-classification of one of your article.

What I am Looking For: Art, tales, poetry, or any fanwork of any of my scips/tales is obviously amazing (5302, 5348, and the aforementioned tale), or something related to Lamplight, Corbenic, or PoyF.

This last part is kinda weird and IDK if it's applicable or okay to ask for this, but I recently got my third article so if someone who's good at CSS wants to design an awesome author page that would also be really fucking cool. I recognize this is kinda weird so feel free to stick to the first one.

I volunteer for pitch hitter, but I recognize that DarkStuff and I have no real rapport so no hard feelings if you don't feel comfortable with banking on me.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: I can draw cartoony character portraits, icons, and simply scenes

What I would like: I would really like a tale or scp based on scp-4010/Andrew Swann's proposal Or art of scp-4205 in the eyes of the beholder/scp-990 dream man.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: SCP or tale. I'm not the best with interpersonal interactions or humor.

What I Am Looking For: SCP, GoI format, or tale about RAISA's technical operations or information security.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Pretty much anything written for whatever your little heart desires. I do SCPs, I do GoI-Formats, I do tales, I do everything in between. I'm best for epistolary and/or humour stuff. I can also do CSS themes and components, and a little bit of graphic design in the vein of logos and such.

What I Am Looking For: This year I'd like something that could be posted to the Wanderer's Library — so that's any fantastical fiction, something that inspires wonder, you know. Doesn't even need to be SCP-related, though it totally can be. Art of the Library or any of its characters would also be very nice!

I'm good to pinch-hit if needed. Santa House will deliver.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can make art, I think my vectors are pretty ok. (examples.) I could write a bit, mainly monologues.

What I Am Looking For: Art or tale about anomalous disease SCP/SCPs. I count parasites and memetic stuff as diseases. Context is free, humorous horror or actions, but minimize body horror if possible—I realize this is a bit unreasonable for request about disease, so I understand if you do what you must.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Prose, short stories, I'd prefer to write something unconnected from a specific canon.

What I Am Looking For: Anything featuring one of my works/characters here on the site.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can make illustrations or short comics. Examples of my work can be found here. I prefer humanoid characters if possible, but I'm also okay with doing scenery shots as well. Unfortunately, my art style is very manga and anime influenced, and I understand that's not very popular here. That being said, I am also willing to do readings of articles or tales, complete with sound effects.
What I Am Looking For: I am desperately craving more content relating to the Antimemetics Division, I'm not picky about what medium. Draw some fanart, write a new tale, anything would be absolutely delightful!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Digital art, vector logos and/or pixel art. Examples here. No NSFW, but other than that I will draw pretty much anything: SCPs, Tales, Series, even Canons.

What I Am Looking For: I would really love to see a high action article or tale involving a collaboration between MTF Tau-5 Samsara and the Department of Tactical Theology. Big bonus points if it doesn't focus on Abrahamic religions.

I volunteer for pinch-hitting.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I can make art of pretty much anything ranging from SCPs to scenes from Tales and what not. My art style is rather flexible so if someone's looking for a specific kind of look I can aim for that.

What I Am Looking For: I'd like to receive a skip loosely based around Kukulkan [Mayan Mythology]/Quetzalcoatl [Aztec Mythology] with any tone.

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: Tales, especially ones that play with format in a fun way. I've done a lot of poetry and play formatting in the past so I could play around with stuff like that, or just a straight-tale, but I think my poetry is where I shine the most. Last year (for an unofficial gift-swap) I made a parody of The Raven about LSF's Big-Egg-J, so yeah… stuff like that I can do if people want it.

What I Am Looking For: Something with Demasqed. It's my magnum opus on the wiki and I'd absolutely love to see a piece of writing or art that either relates to the events of the series, or makes use of one of the characters like Dr. Ozid, Crystal-INE, Chandler, or maybe Dana (the other characters are cool too, I just think those ones have the most side-story potential).

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I can give: Digital art or traditional, 3D mixed media (think clay, wires, fabric, whatever would work well with the piece), prose writing, or if needed some sort of photography; I won’t be able to do cities, but farm stuff is easy.

What I am looking for: A new image for SCP-3604, writing or art of any of my pieces

I can do pinch hitting if it is needed.

Thanks for hosting Elogee and Darkstuff!!

item.title: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
What I Can Give: I am pretty experienced in writing, but not exactly for SCP's. Christmas theming is something I excel at, specifically writing about hot cocoa. I would love to write about hot cocoa. Edit: adding on that I can write tales as a whole, so hot cocoa isn't a strict thing. Note that I'll involve hot cocoa in tales often.

What Am I Looking For: My favorite SCP is Josie the Cat (SCP-529), so I'd love to have an article about Josie in particular (This includes anything, ranging from art, to tales, etc.) I'd prefer an SCP or tale about Josie, but as stated before, Josie in general is something I loved. If you can't do that, feel free to simply write about hot cocoa, I love that stuff!
